$comment: tsconfigFile points at a file that doesn't exist, so Stryker skips its tsconfig step, which needs the JavaScript API that TypeScript 7 lacks. "/.claude" in ignorePatterns stops the sandbox copy failing with ENOTSUP on the .claude/skills symlinks. Remove both once Stryker supports TypeScript 7: https://github.com/stryker-mutator/stryker-js/issues/6111
